notes.title: Anima: Gate of Memories I & II Remaster – An Action-RPG Saga Reforged
notes.notes:
This release rebuilds [b]Gate of Memories[/b] and [b]The Nameless Chronicles[/b] from the ground up, with enhanced visuals, rebalanced combat, and gameplay improvements on a single new title. Whether you're a longtime fan or discovering Gaia for the first time, this is the ultimate way to experience the saga.

Prepare to (re)discover the world of Gaia, the way it's meant to be experienced!

Coming later this year!

WISHLIST NOW!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3592140/Anima_Gate_of_Memories_I__II_Remastered/

[h1][h2][h1]Watch the Reveal Trailer:
[/h1][/h2][/h1]
[previewyoutube=q6XSK6Vjtio;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]UPTATE CHANGES[/b]
Also, along with the announcement, we have done several general bug-fixing of the current version of Anima, to make the game more stable and improve performance.

notes.title: Anima: Song from the Abyss First Trailer and Kickstarter Campaign is LIVE
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We want to announce that Anima Song from the Abyss, the new game from Anima Project, has started its Kickstarter campaign and presents its first trailer.

Anima Song from the Abyss is an action role-playing game (ARPG) with hack and slash style elements in which players explore an interconnected world. The game is the third entry set in the world of Gaïa, from the renowned roleplaying book franchise Anima Beyond Fantasy. The game allows you to control two different characters, the knight Soren and the strange entity Noein through a journey that will take them across the remains of an ancient extinct civilization to discover the secret of its fall...

You can check the trailer in the next link:
https://youtu.be/omzviwu7Wwg

We hope that you will enjoy it!

We are delighted to announce that with the launch of the new Anima title, The Nameless Chronicles, we are going to make a bundle with both games, which will be available from next June 19.

The Nameless Chronicles allows you to play the story of The Nameless. Discover with him a different side of the events that took place in Arcane. If you liked Anima Gate of Memories, you can not miss it.

notes.title: Design a tarot card and win big prizes!
notes.notes:
To celebrate the future release of Anima: Gate of Memories on PS4 boxed, we are inviting you to join in our online competition by designing your own tarot card in the style of Anima.

To qualify for entry, applicants must SUBMIT their artwork to us (on Grandyo https://www.grandyo.com/challenge-15 & SHARE their artwork on social media and include the hashtags #AnimaGOM @animaps @BadlandIndie along with the title.

All submitted entries that comply with the rules can be voted on. 

Rules:

- Submitted artwork must be the applicants own.
- Applicants must be 12 or over to enter.
- You are prohibited to send in any submission that is deemed too "pornographic"

Tips
- Get creative. Have a look on the internet for inspiration on current tarot cards. 
- Watch the Anima: Gate of Memories trailer to get an idea of their style. http://badlandindie.com/anima-gate-of-memories/ 
- Send in your artwork and get your friends, family and anyone you know to vote for you.
